name: self-playing animated loop, portrait, CJK copy
query: 做一个竖版的动图，讲我们的内容循环：选题 → 写 → 发布 → 看数据 → 回到选题，中间是「读者画像」这个共享的东西。要能直接在浏览器里播，我没装什么视频工具。
expected_behavior: Chooses the motion tier — one self-playing HTML — and does not require any video framework
Chooses loop over flowchart, and includes the dashed write-back spokes to the centre hub (without them it is only a circular process)
Uses a portrait viewBox (540x960) and a TALL ellipse (ry > rx), not a landscape ratio re-cropped
Derives arc endpoints from the station cards' own boundaries, so no arc floats free of its card
Accents the edge that closes the loop (last station back to first)
Runs scripts/fetch_fonts.py so the Chinese glyphs are subsetted, and INLINES the font CSS rather than linking it
The delivered HTML opens in a browser and animates with no server, no build step, and no network
